mbbs.name: MBBS — Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery
mbbs.duration: 5 years (Maximum 10 years allowed). Students are allowed a maximum of 4 attempts per professional examination.
mbbs.eligibility: FSc Pre-Medical or A-Level equivalent with at least 60% aggregate marks including Biology and Chemistry. MDCAT minimum 55% for MBBS. Must hold PRC/Domicile of Sindh Province for general merit seats. A-Level/foreign qualifications need IBCC equivalence. MDCAT not required for Foreign National/Overseas Pakistani self-finance (SAT-II 550 or foreign MCAT/UCAT 50% instead).
mbbs.description: MBBS at LUMHS is offered at the main Jamshoro campus, Bilawal Medical College for Boys, and LIMHS Thatta. Curriculum follows PM&DC guidelines with professional examinations each year. Structure: 2 years Basic Medical Sciences, 3 years Clinical curriculum, 1 year House Job.
mbbs.fees: District Merit: 1st Year PKR 68,000 (Admission 20k + Tuition 48k); 2nd-5th Year PKR 48,000/year. UDP Self-Finance: 1st Year PKR 675,000 (Admission 25k + Tuition 650k); 2nd-5th Year PKR 650,000/year. Overseas/Foreign National Self-Finance: 1st Year Admission PKR 50,000 + Tuition US$11,000; 2nd-5th Year US$11,000/year. Common charges: PM&DC Registration PKR 7,000 (once), Transport PKR 15,000/yr, Documents Verification PKR 5,000 (once), Student Activities PKR 10,000 (once), University Development PKR 10,000/yr, Convocation PKR 5,000 (once), Hostel PKR 50,000-55,100/yr.
mbbs.career_prospects: Medical doctor, general practitioner, hospital physician, surgeon, postgraduate specialization (FCPS, MD, MS), academic career.
mbbs.how_to_apply: Fill online form at www.lumhs.edu.pk and admissionportal.lumhs.edu.pk. Choose institution tagged to your district. Print form, attach documents, submit at Leopard Courier Service (LCS), pay PKR 3,500 processing fee. MDCAT registration is separate. Merit = HSSC 50% + MDCAT 50%.
mbbs.required_documents: SSC/Matric certificate and marksheet, HSSC/Intermediate certificate and marksheet, MDCAT result card, CNIC or Form-B, CNIC of father/guardian, PRC Form-C and Domicile of candidate and father, passport-size photographs, processing fee voucher. For self-finance: Demand Draft payable to Vice Chancellor LUMHS Jamshoro.
mbbs.availability: LUMHS main campus Jamshoro, Bilawal Medical College for Boys, LIMHS Thatta

admissions.general_process: Admission to most undergraduate programs (MBBS, BDS, BS degrees) is online through the LUMHS website and centralized admission portal (admissionportal.lumhs.edu.pk for MBBS/BDS). Applicants must fill the form, upload required documents along with a non-refundable processing fee voucher (PKR 5,000 for most BS programs; PKR 3,500 for MBBS/BDS via Leopard Courier). After the Entry Test (for BS programs) or MDCAT (for MBBS/BDS), provisional and final merit lists are displayed on the website. Self-finance/Overseas applicants must also upload a scanned Demand Draft/Pay Order as per the fee structure.
admissions.documents_required: SSC/Matric certificate and marksheet (or O-Level with IBCC equivalence), HSSC/Intermediate certificate and marksheet (or A-Level with IBCC equivalence), Domicile certificate of candidate and father, PRC Form-C, CNIC or Form-B (candidate), Father's CNIC, recent passport-size photographs (usually 6), paid processing fee voucher. Additional for overseas: passport/visa, proof of parent's employment abroad. For self-finance: Demand Draft/Pay Order. For MBBS/BDS: MDCAT result card. Disability certificate if applying under disabled quota. Affidavit on stamp paper attested by First Class Magistrate.
admissions.processing_fee: PKR 5,000 for BS degree/diploma programs (non-refundable Entry Test and processing fee), payable via bank challan at any HBL branch or online via 1Bill. For MBBS/BDS: PKR 3,500 (inclusive of courier charges) paid at Leopard Courier Service. For postgraduate programs: PKR 5,000 for most programs, PKR 20,000 for MD/MS courses. All fees are non-refundable.
admissions.important_dates: Refer to official LUMHS website for admission schedules. For 2025-26, the Self-Finance application window for some BS programs was announced April-May 2026. MBBS/BDS centralised admission process opens after MDCAT results. Entry tests for BS programs typically held in Jamshoro as Computer-Based Test (CBT).
admissions.eligibility_general: MBBS/BDS: Minimum 60% marks in FSc Pre-Medical, valid MDCAT score minimum 55% for MBBS/50% for BDS, mentally and physically fit. DPT/BS Nursing/BS Programs: Minimum 50% marks in FSc, Entry test by LUMHS. MBA: Bachelor's degree, 3-5 years work experience. Postgraduate: MBBS or relevant degree as per PMC/HEC requirements.
admissions.mdcat_info: MDCAT is mandatory for admission to MBBS and BDS programs. For MBBS: minimum 55% score. For BDS: minimum 50% score. Conducted by IBA-Sukkur. For BS programs (DPT, Nursing etc.), LUMHS conducts its own entry test (Biology, Chemistry, Physics, English). Admission formula: 50% HSSC + 50% entry test.
admissions.affidavit: Selected candidates must submit an affidavit on stamp paper (Rs. 200 for MBBS/BDS, Rs. 100 for others) stating: they hold only one valid PRC/Domicile; they will not seek admission elsewhere; all documents are genuine; they will complete the program or pay full fees as penalty; they will not participate in political activities; they will abide by all university rules. Must be attested by a First Class Magistrate.
admissions.migration: Migration is not allowed to or from LUMHS for undergraduate programs. Once admitted, students must complete the entire program at LUMHS. Students sign an affidavit confirming they will not apply for migration. Postgraduate migration may be evaluated on case-by-case basis per PMC/HEC rules.
admissions.postgraduate_process: To apply for postgraduate programs (MS, MD, M.Phil, PhD, FCPS) at LUMHS: Visit admission.lumhs.edu.pk/pg. Register, fill details, upload documents. Generate and deposit challan (PKR 5,000 for most, PKR 20,000 for MD/MS). Print application and submit hard copy to Postgraduate Medical Centre. Appear for computer-based entry test. Contact: pgmc@lumhs.edu.pk | Tel: 022-9213322/9213324.

about.history: Liaquat University of Medical and Health Sciences (LUMHS) was established as Sindh Medical School in 1881, upgraded to a medical college in 1942, and gained full university status in 2001. It is the first public-sector medical university in Sindh and the second oldest medical institution in Pakistan, located in Jamshoro on the right bank of the Indus River approximately 18km northwest of Hyderabad. The campus spans over 570 acres.
about.vision: To be a leading health sciences university imparting quality education, research, and patient care. LUMHS seeks to be a top-tier healthcare institution, producing ingenious academic leaders, medical researchers, and healthcare advocates to serve the global community.
about.mission: To produce competent healthcare professionals, advance medical research, and provide affordable health services to the community. Fostering an ideal learning environment to ensure modern scientific evidence-based practices by imparting critical knowledge, analytical and psychomotor skills, and professional dedication among healthcare students.
about.chancellor: The Governor of Sindh is the Chancellor of LUMHS (ex-officio). The current Governor is Kamran Ali Tessori.
about.recognition: Recognized by Pakistan Medical and Dental Council (PM&DC), Higher Education Commission (HEC), World Health Organization (WHO), and Pakistan Medical Commission (PMC). LUMHS is ISO 9001:2008 certified for Quality Management. Quality assurance overseen by the Quality Enhancement Cell (QEC).
about.constituent_institutes: LUMHS constituent colleges and institutes: Bilawal Medical College for Boys, Institute of Dentistry, Liaquat Institute of Medical and Health Sciences (LIMHS) Thatta (established 2023), People's Nursing School (PNS), Institute of Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Sciences (IPRS), Institute of Bio-Medical Engineering and Technology (IBET), College of Pharmacy, College of Technology, Institute of Gastroenterology and Hepatology. Many nursing, physiotherapy, and paramedical colleges are also affiliated with LUMHS.
about.thatta_campus: Liaquat Institute of Medical and Health Sciences (LIMHS), Thatta is a constituent college of LUMHS established in 2023. Location: Opposite Thatta Cement, Thatta, Sindh (near historic Makli UNESCO World Heritage Site). Programs: MBBS (5 years), DPT (5 years), BS Nursing Generic (4 years), BS Medical Laboratory Technology (4 years), Diploma in Community Midwifery for females (2 years). Candidates from all over Pakistan are eligible. Contact: limhs@lumhs.edu.pk | +92 22 9213111.
about.bilawal_college: Bilawal Medical College (BMC) for Boys is a constituent college of LUMHS providing quality undergraduate medical education in a male-only setting. Located on the LUMHS campus, Jamshoro. One of Pakistan's first public sector boys-only medical colleges. Offers MBBS degree (5 years). Emphasis on problem-based learning, early clinical exposure, and community health.
about.alumni: LUMHS has an active Alumni Centre. Website: www.lumhs.edu.pk/alumni. Email: alumni@lumhs.edu.pk. Alumni can register online. Benefits include career support, library access, healthcare facilities, alumni directory, sports facilities, and accommodation. Punjab Alumni Chapter inaugurated in Lahore (January 2026). International alumni can access degree attestation and verification services.
about.careers: LUMHS advertises faculty, administrative, and support staff positions on its official website. Visit: www.lumhs.edu.pk/careers. Applications via prescribed forms downloadable from the website. Positions announced regularly for LUMHS Jamshoro, LIMHS Thatta, and Bilawal Medical College.
about.affiliated_colleges: LUMHS affiliated colleges across Sindh: MBBS/BDS (Private): Indus Medical College Tando Muhammad Khan, Muhammad Medical College Mirpurkhas, Muhammad Dental College Mirpurkhas, Indus Dental College Tando Muhammad Khan. Nursing Colleges: Jamshoro College of Nursing, JPMC College of Nursing Karachi, Liaquat National College of Nursing Karachi, and many others. Physiotherapy Colleges: National Institute of Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Sciences Hyderabad, Al-Biruni Institute Hyderabad, Royal Institute of Physiotherapy Sukkur, and several others. All affiliated colleges follow LUMHS curriculum and examination system.

policies.attendance: Minimum attendance of 75% in theory and practical classes is required to sit for examinations. Students with less than 75% attendance are not eligible to appear in semester examinations. A waiver of up to 10% (5% by VC, 5% by Waiver Committee) may be granted on medical grounds. Attendance below 65% means automatic failure in that semester. Attendance below 40% means the student cannot appear in re-sit exams. Clinical attendance for nursing students is 100% of clinical hours as per PNC rules.
policies.promotion: LUMHS follows a semester system (except MBBS/BDS which is annual). Students failing a semester are promoted to the next semester while taking re-sit exams. If they fail re-sit, they are reverted to the junior batch to repeat the subject. Maximum of 4 attempts per professional examination. Duration limits: MBBS max 10 years, BDS max 8 years.
policies.harassment: LUMHS has a strict policy against sexual harassment and discrimination per the Protection Against Harassment of Women at the Workplace Act 2010. An Inquiry Committee with at least one woman member is in place. Complaints filed in writing to the Committee or Ombudsman. Investigation within 30 days. Penalties include censure, withholding promotion, compulsory retirement, removal from service, and fines. Retaliation against complainants is prohibited.
policies.freeship: Freeship is a tuition fee waiver (full or half) for eligible students. Eligibility: Orphan or single parent, Poor cum merit (family income less than PKR 50,000/month), High academic performance (GPA 3.0 or above), Sibling basis. Rules: Only tuition fees waived, Granted from 2nd year onward, Not exceeding 10% of students per discipline, Cannot be combined with other scholarships, Not applicable to self-finance or overseas students. Fresh applications invited annually.
policies.code_of_conduct: LUMHS students must observe the Code of Honour: Respect for order, morality, personal honour and rights of others; Respect teachers, officers, and authorities; Loyalty to the country; Keep clean in body and mind; Help fellow beings. Acts of indiscipline include: indecent language, immodest dress, disorderly behavior; defiance of university authority; shouting slogans, staging strikes, unauthorized processions; consumption of alcohol or drugs; organizing clubs without permission; damage to university property. Penalties range from fine to rustication or permanent expulsion.
policies.question_bank: The Question Bank (Q Bank) is a centralized secure digital repository for all examination questions at LUMHS. Used for all undergraduate, postgraduate, and allied health sciences exams. Questions tagged by subject, topic, Bloom's Taxonomy level, and difficulty. Strict security and encryption protocols enforced. Only authorized personnel have access.
policies.faculty_registration: All teaching faculty at LUMHS must be registered with PM&DC. Faculty members need a valid PMDC Faculty Registration Certificate (FRC). New faculty must apply for FRC within 7 days of joining. Contact the Registrar's office for assistance.

research.journals: LUMHS publishes: 1. Liaquat Medical Research Journal (LMRJ) — HEC recognized (Y Category); Indexed in DOAJ; Gold Open Access, double-blind peer review. 3. Research Journal of Biomedical Engineering (RJBME) — Published by IBET. 4. Dental Journal LUMHS (DJLUMHS) — Coming soon.
research.ethics_committee: The Research Ethics Committee (REC)/Ethical Review Committee (ERC) reviews and approves all research proposals involving human subjects, tissues, or genetic material. Ensures ethical standards (Helsinki Declaration). Protects subjects from harm. Reviews and approves/rejects proposals. Monitors ongoing research. Maintains a database of approved proposals. Researchers must submit synopses to REC before beginning data collection.
